name: Aestilan
description: Aestilan was a world located in the Demetras sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Following the Battle of Yavin, the world was scouted by Rebel Alliance forces seeking for a new base. Aestilan was known for its rock worms making the planetary mantle very fragile.
